beats.shot: extreme close-up on Titan's peaking bicep gripping a dumbbell
beats.does: Squeezes the dumbbell at the top as the bicep glows neon green
Lowers the dumbbell and swings his shoulder forward
beats.says: Using momentum shifts the work away.

beats.shot: close-up on Titan's elbow and ribs
beats.does: Locks his elbow tightly against his side
beats.says: Lock your elbows to your sides.

beats.shot: close-up on Titan's forearm and the dumbbell
beats.does: Starts a slow strict upward curl of the dumbbell
Curls the dumbbell to the top as the muscle flares neon green again

beats.shot: wide on Titan standing on the glossy dark floor
beats.does: Slowly lowers the dumbbell downward while the floor mirrors him
beats.says: Lower the weight with total control.

beats.shot: close-up on Titan's hand holding the dumbbell
beats.does: Holds the dumbbell perfectly still at the bottom position
beats.says: What muscle should we train next?

caption: Strict form equals better results. What muscle should we train next? #bicepcurl #fitnessanimation #workouttips #muscleisolation #gymform
